classification.difficultyReason: Recover the overlap from two category totals, construct a Venn diagram and calculate probabilities from its regions.

content.prompt: A jar contains 27 balls. Twenty of the balls have a star on them and 10 of the balls have an elephant printed on them. Every ball has at least one of these symbols on it.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Draw a Venn diagram to illustrate this.

answer.short: $S$: star; $E$: elephant. Star only: 17; both: 3; elephant only: 7; neither: 0.
answer.worked:
Let $S$ represent balls with a star and $E$ represent balls with an elephant. Every ball belongs to $S\cup E$.

$$\begin{align*}|S\cap E|&=20+10-27\\|S\cap E|&=3\end{align*}$$

Star only: $20-3=17$. Elephant only: $10-3=7$. Neither: $0$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: If one ball is withdrawn at random, what is the probability of choosing:

children.label: i
children.prompt: a ball with an elephant printed on it?

answer.worked:
There are 10 balls with an elephant among 27 equally likely balls.

$$P(E)=\frac{10}{27}.$$

children.label: ii
children.prompt: a ball with a star and an elephant printed on it?

answer.worked:
The overlap contains 3 balls.

$$\begin{align*}P(S\cap E)&=\frac{3}{27}\\P(S\cap E)&=\frac{1}{9}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: iii
children.prompt: a ball with an elephant printed once but without a star?

answer.worked:
The elephant-only region contains $10-3=7$ balls.

$$P(E\cap S^{c})=\frac{7}{27}.$$
